infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spider Cards uses the camera to photograph spiders so it can generate trading cards.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Spider Cards needs photo access to save card images you share.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spider Cards uses your approximate location (city level) to tag captures and power regional leaderboards. Optional per capture.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Spider Cards to access your camera to photograph spiders.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Spider Cards to use your approximate location to tag captures.
